Name Nice3 (The Nice Cube, Nicecube)
Spacecraft type CubeSat
Units or mass 1U
Status cancelled
Organization Universite C´ ote d’Azur
Institution University
Entity Academic / Education
Headquarters France
Oneliner

Demonstrate laser transmitter and optical link to ground in a 1U CubeSat.
Description

Establish a data optical link between the satellite and the ground, while keeping it in a 1U CubeSat format. The second goal of the mission is to demonstrate a high-enough transmission rate (higher than 1 Kb/s).
